name: Apothecary Zamah
summary: In Thunder Bluff, Apothecary Zamah awaits a fragile brew from the Barrens. It must reach her laboratory beneath Spirit Rise before it loses its strength.

sections.title: A Fragile Cargo
sections.body: Apothecary Helbrim has turned fungal blooms from the Barrens oases into a delicate emulsion. The brew weakens soon after it is made. Helbrim cannot reach Mulgore in time, so he entrusts the flask to a reliable runner bound for Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Under the Gazes of the Shamans
sections.body: Apothecary Zamah works in the Pools of Vision, a cavern beneath Spirit Rise's sacred heights. Forsaken mages and priests share this refuge underground. Below the tauren sanctuary, the Royal Apothecary Society quietly studies raw materials gathered across the continent.

faq.q: Why is there a time limit on this delivery?
faq.answer: Helbrim's fungal emulsion is chemically volatile. Left exposed or untreated too long, its compounds break down and lose potency, leaving it useless for Zamah's work.

faq.q: Where can I find Apothecary Zamah?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zamah can be found in Thunder Bluff's Pools of Vision. The cavern entrance is hidden on Spirit Rise, beneath the shamans' tents.

Apothecary Helbrim is an alchemist of the Royal Apothecary Society, stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He studies local plants and animals to learn how Kalimdor's native life might serve the Forsaken.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society doing in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society quietly studies specimens gathered across Kalimdor in Thunder Bluff's Pools of Vision. The Forsaken, allies in the Horde, keep representatives such as Zamah there and maintain supply links with other outposts.

faq.q: What were the fungal spores originally used for?
faq.answer: Fungal spores grow around the Barrens' lush oases, thriving in the desert. Helbrim rendered them down to study their biological traits and alchemical uses before sending them to Zamah.

faq.q: What happens if the timer runs out?
faq.answer: If the timer expires, the emulsion spoils and loses its potency. You must return to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads for a fresh batch to carry to Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As an Undead, you carry Helbrim's work to Zamah and strengthen the Royal Apothecary Society's hidden research network across central Kalimdor's frontier.
As a Tauren, you may welcome the Forsaken as allies while eyeing their strange brews in the sacred Pools of Vision with suspicion.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep communication and supplies moving between the Barrens outposts and Thunder Bluff's high mesa.
